gen-gf-underdog-gf-libre-franklin: Smooth, tube-like lines with a wide horseshoe c. Libre Franklin sits underneath in a plain sans, its splayed c terminal and crisp, workmanlike manner giving the loud heading something steady to lean on.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-line-seed-jp: Approachable is the first thing LINE Seed JP says, with horizontals as heavy as its verticals and counters that let the eye slip in and out. Underdog's bold, wire-bent display letters carry the drama above it.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-livvic: Underdog brings a big, expressive voice, every curve drawn without a shift in weight and its c flung open like a horseshoe. Livvic follows in a sans with no stress in its curves, friendly and quiet enough to let that voice finish.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-lunasima: Bent-wire strokes, loud and unshaded. Underdog is best at making a line announce itself, while Lunasima, a sans-serif with c tips that never creep toward touching, is best at staying out of the way.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-lxgw-marker-gothic: LXGW Marker Gothic has a wide-open c like a bracelet pulled apart, with a smooth, modest gradient from thick strokes to thin. Over a full page it reads smoothly and quietly, a gentle foil to Underdog.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-m-plus-1: M PLUS 1 reads like a fineliner on paper, a plain sans with big open eyes on every e and a. Underdog's heavy, wire-smooth display letters ride above it and give the page its volume.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-m-plus-1p: Smooth, signage-plain lines with a horseshoe c. M PLUS 1p, a sans-serif with openness at every curve end, would carry a long passage lightly, never crowding the eye.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-m-plus-2: Underdog speaks first, a display face whose curves never change weight and whose c gapes like a horseshoe. M PLUS 2 settles in beside it as a sans-serif with a fixed nib width, approachable and a little more reserved.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-m-plus-code-latin: Approachable is the mood M PLUS Code Latin sets, with neon-tube letters and a c as wide as a pitcher's mouth. And Underdog, expressive and commanding, is the one that grabs attention while the plain sans quietly keeps the words clear.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c: No thick-thin shift anywhere in Underdog's curves. M PLUS Rounded 1c, a sans-serif with terminals that stop short of curling back in, keeps a longer stretch of text soft and unfussy.
